neighbours.label: the digit '7' right after a '5' inside a code or strain name (C57, O157, B57)
fire: The experiments were run on male C57BL/6 mice housed in standard cages.
Health officials traced the outbreak to E. coli O157:H7 in a batch of lettuce.
Wild-type and knockout animals on a C57 background were compared at twelve weeks.
The bomber squadron flew the old B57 aircraft until the program ended.
Investigators confirmed that strain O157 had contaminated the ground beef.
Litters from C57 black 6 females were weaned at three weeks of age.
The recall notice listed part number X57 among the affected switches.
Our lab orders inbred C57BL/6J mice from a commercial supplier every month.
quiet: The experiments were run on male BALB/c mice housed in standard cages.
Health officials traced the outbreak to E. coli O104:H4 in a batch of lettuce.
Wild-type and knockout animals on a C3H background were compared at twelve weeks.
The bomber squadron flew the old B52 aircraft until the program ended.
Investigators confirmed that strain O26 had contaminated the ground beef.
Litters from DBA/2 females were weaned at three weeks of age.
The recall notice listed part number X38 among the affected switches.
Our lab orders outbred CD-1 mice from a commercial supplier every month.

notes: Card: 30/32 top peaks are '7' preceded by '5' (C57BL/6, O157:H7, B57). Near misses use other digits after 5, or 7 after other digits.
